scope.population: 2,480,267 maker-matched fills of 2,480,267 in the trade-print panel, aggregated per maker; the concentration and incidence figures take every matched maker with no fill floor, and only the ranked loser and earner tables floor at 10 fills
scope.window: 10 days present among the matched rows, day-of-month 4-13; the calendar dates of the window are declared by its producer, build_quickwin_markouts.py

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

_meta.sign_convention: mo10 positive = taker profited = MAKER adverse-selected; aggregated per maker as-is
_meta.headline: per-DOLLAR (notional-normalized) maker-loss concentration; raw dollar-loss Gini is a demoted size-artefact diagnostic, never cited alone
_meta.reference_caveat: markout is a trade-print VWAP, not a book mid; dollar figures are signed-markout cost, and the adverse-selection interpretation is held pending the book-mid (I4) check
_meta.rank_floor_note: rank_floor_fills=10 is the floor for entering the ranked maker tables (worst_losers / best_earners); the concentration and incidence figures are over ALL matched makers with no fill floor

accounting_identity.label: accounting identity (sum of signed markout cost is partition-invariant), not an independent validation
accounting_identity.note: ungrouped == maker-grouped == taker-grouped by construction (each fill's signed cost is counted exactly once under any partition); the equality validates nothing independent

per_dollar_loss_concentration.measure: per-maker notional-weighted mean markout faced (dollar loss / dollar notional, bps); size-stripped
per_dollar_loss_concentration.headline_note: this is the HEADLINE: per-dollar (size-stripped) maker-loss concentration is only MODERATE (Gini ~0.55), so the maker-side adverse selection is NOT carried by a tiny handful of makers -- the biggest dollar losers are just the biggest makers (see the size-artefact diagnostic below)

dollar_loss_concentration_size_artefact.label: DOLLAR-LOSS concentration is a TRADE-SIZE artefact -- do NOT cite the raw Gini alone
dollar_loss_concentration_size_artefact.size_artefact_note: dollar_loss_gini_size_artefact_do_not_cite (~0.97) is essentially the per_maker_notional_gini (~0.98): the dollar-loss concentration is pure trade-size inequality, not loss dispersion. Cite the per_dollar_loss_gini in (1) instead, never this raw figure alone

BTC.net_sign_note: positive net => makers collectively LOSE (are adverse-selected); negative => makers collectively earn spread
